context.title: To an Unknown God
context.summary: Paul preaches in Thessalonica, where opponents riot, and in Berea, where Jews eagerly search the Scriptures. In Athens he debates philosophers and speaks at the Areopagus about the God they worship as unknown.
context.background: Athens was the old center of Greek philosophy. Epicureans held that the gods were distant and pleasure the goal of life; Stoics taught living in line with reason and nature. Luke's title for Thessalonica's officials, 'rulers of the city' (politarchs), matches inscriptions found there.

customs.note: 'Mars' hill', a rocky hill near the Acropolis, and also the name of an ancient council that met there and oversaw matters of religion and teaching.
'We are also his offspring' comes from the Greek poet Aratus. 'In him we live, and move' is often linked to Epimenides, though that is less certain.

watchFor: Paul starts from creation, not from the Old Testament, with this audience (vv. 24–28).

people.name: Paul
people.summary: Saul was born about the same time as our Lord. His circumcision-name was Saul, and probably the name Paul was also given to him in infancy “for use in the Gentile world,” as “Saul” would be his Hebrew home-name.

people.name: Jesus
people.also: Immanuel, Emmanuel, Messiah, Shiloh, Christ, Jesus Christ, Messias
people.summary: Anointed, the Greek translation of the Hebrew word rendered “Messiah”, the official title of our Lord, occurring five hundred and fourteen times in the New Testament.

people.name: Silas
people.summary: Wood, a prominent member of the church at Jerusalem; also called Silvanus. He and Judas, surnamed Barsabas, were chosen by the church there to accompany Paul and Barnabas on their return to Antioch from the council of the apostles and elders (Acts 15:22), as bearers of the decree adopted by the council.

people.name: Jason
people.summary: He that will cure, the host of Paul and Silas in Thessalonica. The Jews assaulted his house in order to seize Paul, but failing to find him, they dragged Jason before the ruler of the city (Acts 17:5-9).

people.name: Timotheus
people.summary: Honouring God, a young disciple who was Paul’s companion in many of his journeyings. His mother, Eunice, and his grandmother, Lois, are mentioned as eminent for their piety (2 Tim. 1:5).

people.name: Damaris
people.summary: A heifer, an Athenian woman converted to Christianity under the preaching of Paul (Acts 17:34).

people.name: Dionysius
people.summary: The Areopagite, one of Paul’s converts at Athens (Acts 17:34).

places.name: Amphipolis
places.summary: City on both sides, a Macedonian city, a great Roman military station, through which Paul and Silas passed on their way from Philippi to Thessalonica, a distance of 33 Roman miles from Philippi (Acts 17:1).

places.name: Apollonia
places.summary: A city of Macedonia between Amphipolis and Thessalonica, from which it was distant about 36 miles.

places.name: Thessalonica
places.summary: A large and populous city on the Thermaic bay. It was the capital of one of the four Roman districts of Macedonia, and was ruled by a praetor.

places.name: Berea
places.summary: A city of Macedonia to which Paul with Silas and Timotheus went when persecuted at Thessalonica (Acts 17:10, 13), and from which also he was compelled to withdraw, when he fled to the sea-coast and thence sailed to Athens (14, 15).

places.name: Athens
places.summary: The capital of Attica, the most celebrated city of the ancient world, the seat of Greek literature and art during the golden period of Grecian history.

places.name: Areopagus
places.summary: The Areopagus or rocky hill in Athens, north-west of the Acropolis, where the Athenian supreme tribunal and court of morals was held.

events.title: Second Missionary Journey
events.summary: Passage: Acts 15:1–18:23. People: Simon, Paul, Luke, Silas, Barnabas, Timotheus and others. Lasted about 3 years.

events.title: Uproar in Thessalonica
events.summary: Passage: Acts 17:1–9. People: Jason, Silas, Paul. Place: Thessalonica. Lasted about 3 months.

events.title: Mission to Berea
events.summary: Passage: Acts 17:10–15. People: Timotheus, Silas, Paul. Place: Berea. Lasted about 1 month.

events.title: Paul preaches in Athens
events.summary: Passage: Acts 17:16–34. People: Damaris, Dionysius, Paul. Place: Areopagus, Athens.
